name: Sissy Maker
source: You play as, James, a young landlord and his only tenant, Chris. Your objective of the game is to help Chris achieve his dream of becoming a full-fledged transsexual woman (and settle a sizable rental debt at the same time).
translation: 你扮演詹姆斯，一位年轻的房东和他唯一的房客克里斯。你的游戏目标是帮助克里斯实现成为一名成熟的变性女性的梦想（同时还清巨额租金债务）。
